theme.$description: The two colors an application chooses, set on :root at run time; every other shade derives from them.

primary.$description: The application's main color, set on :root; primary and ring derive from it. Never read it in a component: use color.primary.

secondary.$description: The application's second color, set on :root; accent and halo derive from it. Never read it in a component: use color.accent.
